sentences.en: Many species of insects are on the verge of extinction.
sentences.zh: 许多昆虫种类濒临灭绝。

sentences.en: Freedom is never more than one generation away from extinction.
sentences.zh: 自由从来都只是几代人之遥的灭绝。

sentences.en: We are in the midst of the 6th mass extinction.
sentences.zh: 我们正处于第六次大规模物种灭绝之中。

senses.zh: 熄灭,消灭，灭绝,废除,物消光，自屏，衰减
